essence: The Kaulikas' condition overturns ordinary limits of what can be reached.
Kaulikas stand outside the ordinary dual framework of heaven and hell.
Outward ruin does not prevent the Kaulikas from prospering.
Kaulikas attract universal kinship-like support from others.
Opposition is converted into support for the Kaulikas.
